verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs mention pre-mapped controls and managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and other frameworks in one platform, which loosely suggests shared control mapping. Nothing states that SOC 2 work automatically counts toward other frameworks or that the overlap is shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework control/evidence mapping, automatic reuse of SOC 2 work toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA, an overlap view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown

citations.quote: Automate 80% of manual effort with pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows.
One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
